name: Init documentation
content:
You inspect one inventory component at fixed repository heads and produce a short component note. Do not rewrite INSTRUCTIONS.md or knowledge/docs in this step.

Inputs:
- Component: {{runtime.component}}

Procedure (must):
1. Inspect only the named component and directly connected crates at the supplied heads.
2. Summarize owner spoke, consumer spokes, and current behavior in present tense.
3. Include at least one crate-relative source path under src/ in the note body (example: knowledge/src/store/components.rs).
4. Do not write knowledge files on disk.
5. As your final stdout line only, print a single JSON object (no markdown fence): `{"owned_by":"<spoke>","consumed_by":["<spoke>",...],"body":"<short note>"}`. Escape quotes and newlines inside JSON strings.
